gifts.name: Espresso shot
gifts.line: Espresso? You know me. Don't tell anyone you know me.

gifts.name: Morning paper
gifts.line: A newspaper! A real one! Paper you can hold! Thank you, kid.

gifts.name: Cannoli
gifts.line: Cannoli. You shouldn't have. You really shouldn't, it was twenty coins.

gifts.name: Slice of pizza
gifts.line: A slice! Plain cheese! You get me. Nobody gets me.

items.name: Persian rug
items.line: A rug! Now it's an office. Before, it was a situation.

items.name: Bed for Luc
items.line: A bed for Luc. He'll ignore it for a week, then never leave it.

items.name: Neon "$" sign
items.line: Neon! Classy. Very 1987. I love it.

items.name: Deluxe espresso machine
items.line: Look at her. Chrome. Red. Beautiful. Paid for in full, right?

items.name: Green wallpaper
items.line: Wallpaper. Like a real office. Like a real accountant. Which I am.

items.name: Blue tie
items.line: Blue tie? Okay. It's a power move. I'll allow it.

items.name: Sunday vest
items.line: The Sunday vest. My mother would cry. Good tears.
